svg.text: DATA-4x-logic front face (towards the port wall), to scale: 100 × 70 mm, the routed board's footprints
one block per DUT, behind its port:
each pin chain runs straight up
the names sit under the header:
when you look down into the drawer
the port numbers sit by the USB-C,
docs fit the whole 2 × 6 on the
nothing shows that a port is on
